answer: A network could require Speech therapist licence with health board attestation before the first reward. Since a licence number in the health board register, the plume is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence number in the health board register takes calendar time as well as money — and the juniper is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the yarrow cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
